content.comment_body: Hello, I recently purchased a [product_name] for a small pump control project. I created my program using [product_name] [version_no]. I tried connecting to my [product_name] via Ethernet cable. I've configured the IP addresses, but although my device is detected, I can't establish a connection. The error message says "Unable to connect to remote device". Could you offer any advice on what I might have misconfigured? The hardware I have is [article_no]. I've attached photos for reference. Thank you for your assistance!

Your device with [article_no] is a [product_name] [version_no]. To connect, you need to use [product_name] [version_no] with this hardware. You can obtain the latest software update from [url], which includes download and installation instructions for the upgrade.
Thank you for your help. I spent hours trying to resolve this issue!

analysis.insight_summary: A user attempted to connect a newly acquired [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] software over Ethernet but was unable to complete the connection, although the device was recognized. The underlying issue was incompatibility between the software version and the hardware version, and error messages did not indicate this clearly. This causes frustration and demonstrates the need for more transparent compatibility information between hardware and software from [company_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated straightforward connectivity between their [product_name] [version_no] hardware and [product_name] software without encountering compatibility problems. They hoped for a setup process that would offer clearer and more informative error feedback.
